prompt: LinkedIn Jobs (sa.linkedin.com/jobs/search and sa.linkedin.com/jobs/view pages). Search each track title with location Saudi Arabia / Riyadh, f_TPR=r259200 (past 3 days) then r604800. Include ONLY sa.linkedin.com/jobs/view/... URLs.
Bayt.com (bayt.com/en/saudi-arabia/jobs/... and bayt.com/ar/saudi-arabia/jobs/...). Search each track title in English and Arabic; Riyadh first. Include only individual job-posting URLs.
GulfTalent (gulftalent.com/saudi-arabia/jobs/...) and Naukrigulf (naukrigulf.com). Search each track title. Include only individual posting URLs.
Indeed Saudi (sa.indeed.com) and Glassdoor (Saudi jobs). Search each track title. Include only individual posting URLs.

Career pages of audit/tax/advisory firms in Saudi Arabia: KPMG, PwC, EY, Deloitte, BDO, Grant Thornton, Crowe, RSM, Baker Tilly, PKF, Moore, Forvis Mazars, Andersen, Al-Kharashi, HLB, UHY, Kreston, Nexia. Tax Manager/Senior, Zakat & Tax, Indirect Tax, Accounting Advisory, Outsourcing/BPS, FAAS in KSA. Include the direct posting URL on the firm site or its ATS.

Recruitment agencies active in KSA (Hays, Michael Page, Robert Walters, Cooper Fitch, Nadia Global, Kinetic, Charterhouse, Mackenzie Jones, Propel, Antal) and career portals of PIF / semi-government / large groups (NEOM, ROSHN, Qiddiya, Diriyah, Red Sea Global, Elm, Takamol, stc, Almarai, SABIC, Ma'aden, Tamkeen, Alturki, Alfanar, Jarir, BinDawood, Nahdi). Finance manager / controller / accounting manager / tax roles. Include the direct posting URL.

Aggregators and Arabic-title boards: Google Jobs (google.com/search?q=...&ibp=htl;jobs), Jadarat (jadarat.sa), Tanqeeb, Wadhefa, Monster Gulf, Foundit Gulf. Search English AND Arabic titles (مدير مالي، رئيس حسابات، مدير حسابات، مدير ضرائب، محاسب زكاة وضريبة، مراقب مالي). Follow through to the ORIGINAL posting URL when the aggregator links to one.
